args.message: 201 customers are in the bronze tier or have at least one order with status 'ok'. Every customer with an 'ok' order already makes up those 201, and every bronze customer is among them, so no one is added or double-counted when the two groups are combined. Of the 202 customers, the only one left out is id 9001 (Frank Moreau, gold tier), who has no 'ok' orders.
